title: House advances bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
summary: The House has taken a significant step by advancing a bipartisan bill aimed at regulating utility costs associated with AI data centers. This legislation proposes a framework that states can implement to ensure that the financial burdens of energy expenses linked to data centers are not unfairly transferred to consumers. By establishing these regulations, the bill seeks to balance the interests of the technology sector with those of the public, promoting a more sustainable approach to energy consumption in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence.
